title: Update hero text to target worldwide learners

requirements.text: Update the subtitle/tagline span element on the Home page hero section (located at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[1]/div[4]/div[1]/span[2]) to reflect that the course is for learners worldwide, not only Indian learners. Replace any text referencing 'Indian learners' with inclusive language such as 'learners worldwide' or 'students around the world'.

quotes: Not only for Indian learners but of learners worldwide

acceptanceCriteria: The targeted span element no longer references 'Indian learners' exclusively.
The updated text communicates that the course is open to learners worldwide.
No other content on the page is changed.

constraints: Only modify the specific span element identified by the XPath; do not alter surrounding hero content or other sections.
nonGoals: Changing any other page text or layout.
Updating SEO metadata or Google Search Console settings.
